Hey JavaScript… Python’s got async too! So what exactly is async, and why should you care about it in Python? Since Python has become the go-to language for AI, data, and backend services, understanding asynchronous programming is more important than ever. If you’re making calls to LLMs, APIs, or any external service, async gives you a powerful way to manage those operations without your program sitting idle and wasting time.
